evidence_candidates.excerpt: TierTrain evaluates proactive tensor movement across HBM, DRAM, NVMM, and a real CXL-attached memory. The authors report a smaller fast-memory footprint with a workload-dependent performance overhead, showing that placement policy matters alongside media characteristics.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: A 2025 ISMM study reports that DNN training can trade fast-tier footprint for 1-16% overhead using proactive tiering on a real CXL-attached system, so data-placement policy is part of the memory architecture outcome.
